tasks.description: Analyze the variation in wind speed across different altitude layers (10m to 180m) to understand wind shear patterns.
Assess the consistency of wind direction across different heights to determine directional stability.
Calculate the gust-to-mean wind speed ratio to evaluate turbulence intensity and its impact on structural safety.
Estimate the wind energy potential at turbine hub heights (80m, 120m) based on wind speed data.
Identify the optimal turbine height by analyzing wind conditions at different altitudes.
Analyze hourly wind trends to understand day vs night wind behavior and identify diurnal patterns.
Evaluate the duration of favorable wind speeds for energy generation to assess wind persistence.
Detect wind veer patterns with altitude to understand changes in wind direction.
Identify calm periods that may impact energy production and detect low wind events.
Detect extreme wind gusts to issue safety alerts and warnings.
Analyze wind speed and direction patterns across different seasons to understand seasonal variations and optimize wind energy production.
Calculate and compare statistical measures (e.g., mean, standard deviation) of wind speed and direction at each altitude level to gain insights into altitude-specific wind characteristics.
Apply clustering algorithms to group similar wind events based on wind speed, direction, and gusts, allowing for the identification of patterns and relationships in wind data.
Examine wind speed and direction patterns at specific times of day (e.g., morning, afternoon, evening) to understand diel variations in wind behavior.
Compute cross-correlations between wind speeds at different altitudes to quantify the relationships between wind patterns at various heights.
